source.text:
9 February 2026
National Revenue Assessment Office
Our reference: QY227530

Dear B O'Connor,

Our records show you are required to complete a return for the year ending 5 April 2026. Your unique taxpayer reference is 54990 45301. Please keep it safe and quote it whenever you contact us.

A paper return has an earlier deadline than one filed online. The general filing dates for every year are printed in the box below; where this letter gives you a date, that date applies.

Your return must reach us within 14 days of 9 February 2026. A return received after that date attracts an automatic penalty of £100.00 even if no tax is owed.

Any tax you owe for the year is payable by the same date. If you cannot pay in full, call us on 0300 200 0000 before the date passes.

If you no longer need to complete a return — for instance you have stopped being self-employed — write to us and we will review your record.

Paper returns: 31 October following the end of the tax year. Online returns and any balancing payment: 31 January following the end of the tax year. Interest runs from the day after a payment date.

Yours sincerely,
Suzanne King
National Revenue Assessment Office

HOW WE USE YOUR INFORMATION

We hold the details on this letter to administer your account and to meet our legal duties. We do not sell personal information. Our full privacy notice sets out what we hold, how long we keep it and who we share it with, and is available on request from the address at the head of this letter.

Where we share information with another organisation it is because the law requires it or because that organisation acts for us under a written agreement. We keep records for as long as the account is open and for six years afterwards.
